Markost Station is a station on Wanderer Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Jupiter. This station will serve Kinight Line, Tachyon Line and India Line in the future, and passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 3301 (Lilyblack Stop).

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Chromatic Equitocracy.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Chromatic Equitocracy 03:13
Serenities of Parity 02:45

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the last station to be built in 2021.
  • To Pay tribute to Stand News, a now-defunct Online News Website based in Hong Kong, a Station Art resembling the icon of Stand News is also built above the Concourse of this Station. This arrangement is similar to that of Apple Hill Station.
  • Despite being built at the same continent as the then-unnamed Teraleros and Poloros, this station administratively belonged to Jupiter as it is situated at the Exclave of Jupiter in that continent. This arrangement is similar to Tsuen Wan District having an exclave on Lantau Island in Hong Kong as most of the Lantau Island belongs to the Islands District.[2]
  • With an interstation distance of 10.18 km between this station and Cranerock Mount Station, it holds the record for the longest non-express train, non-veloduct interstation distance of any Standard Railway Nazca Railway line in Los Sengas Division. Due to the long interstation distance involved, signs are placed at each kilometer on The Great Liberty Bridge to indicate the distance to and from this station and Cranerock Mount Station.[3]
  • After going through The Great Liberty Bridge, the next station announcement would be played once again on both sides. A similar arrangement is also seen for Flask Line before entering Internal Sea East Station and Flask East Checkpoint.[4]
  • Due to the black and white color scheme of this station, colored wool would be placed at each platform representing the line served by that station. The colored side would be placed at the travelling direction of the platform.[5]

Future Development[]

  • While it was not explicitly mentioned in the Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline, Kinight Line, Tachyon Line and India Line will serve this station as seen from the Station Control Room of this station.

History[]

  • December 30 2021: The Platforms and Concourse Structure of this station completed construction.[6] At the same day, this station completed construction.[7]
  • December 31 2021: This Station began services alongside Wanderer Line.
  • May 20 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[8]

Fun Facts[]

  • 11 Masts, in the order of increasing height from the north to the south, are seen at the top of this station to allude to the theme of this station. Moreover, tiny "masts" are also seen at the resting chairs at the Platform level of this station.

History[]

  • June 10 2022: This Station completed construction.[3]

Historical Events[]

2014[]

  • Nazca Railway Terracept Division Hartasy Line Leisura Step Station began operations.

2015[]

  • Nazca Railway Stadium Line, Arcgo Line Origin Station began operations. Arcgo Line is established.

2016[]

  • Nazca Ferry abandoned plans to build a pier on Brain Island.

2017[]

  • Kasukano Train Railway was renamed Peckern Metro after all the original developers left Los Sengas in the 5-1 Incident. The then Kasukano Train Railway suspended all operations.

2020[]

  • Project Nazca Terracept now permanently open.
  • Royal Railway Eastern Line Vertow Valley Station began operations. Eastern Line is established.

2021[]

  • Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Sheung Yam Line Skuld Road Garden Stop began operations. Sheung Yam Line is established and extended to The Acacian Stop.

Historical Events[]

2013[]

  • Nazca Railway Terracept Division Origin Line, Edward Line Fare Well Cliff Station began operations, but as Edward Line have yet to begin development, Edward Line did not begin operations.

2014[]

  • Nazca Railway Terracept Division Hartasy Line Key Lake Station began operations.

2015[]

  • Nazca Railway Urban Line, East Ring Line High Mesa Station began operations. Urban Line is established.

2016[]

  • The temporary route between Sanfo Island and Beam Island for Nazca Ferry began operations.

2017[]

  • Nazca Railway East Ring Line Squirrel Tail Station began operations. Moreover, this station, along with Perquel Island Station, is the second instance of Nazca Railway having two stations on a single island after Airship Island Station and Airship Deck Station.

2018[]

  • Nazca Railway Interisland Line Wholeheart Island Station began operations.

2024[]

  • Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Wai Kam Stop completed construction.

safeHtml:
Mayfair Garden is one of the Sub-Districts of Winsol. It is located at the Central Side of North Winsol, and its District Code is 29-19.

Contents

  • 1 History

History[]

The name of this Sub-District originates from the fact that a foreigner who passed by found the scenic views of this vicinity fascinating, and left a sign saying "Mayfair Garden" on a Meadow in this District, which has since become the namesake of this District.

Mayfair Garden was not a part of the Asylum New Town, but as the developer of Asylum also began developing Winsol, the area in Winsol to the north of Route 18 is now seen as a part of Asylum New Town. Vermillion Stone is the central section of the Extension.

Mayler Airport is the first public airport and International Airport in Los Sengas located at Sava Threeler in Los Sengas. While it originally opened as a public airport, it was subsequently converted to a private airport before being once again converted to a public airport.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Composition
    • 2.1 Terminal 1
    • 2.2 Terminal 2
  • 3 Airlines and Destinations
  • 4 Air Traffic
  • 5 Ground Transport
  • 6 Future Development
  • 7 Gallery
  • 8 See Also

History[]

  • June 16 2015: Mayler Airport completed construction, and space was reserved for Arcgo Line Mayler Airport Station.
  • May 16 2016: Due to Delta Line works and the expansion of Mayler Airport, the old station was demolished.
  • August 31 2024: Mayler Airport 1 Station completed construction.
  • September 4 2024: Mayler Airport 1 Station began operations.
  • September 21 2024: Skyward Line is established and began to serve Mayler Airport 1 Station. At the same day, the Terminal 1 Ramp became connected to the runway.
  • October 3 2024: Nazca Railway has announced the construction of Mayler Airport 2 Station for Skyward Line and Swift Line.[1]
  • October 8 2024: Mayler Airport 2 Station completed construction.
  • October 20 2024: Mayler Airport 2 Station began operations.
  • 2024: Mayler Airport completed expansion.

Composition[]

Mayler Airport features a total of two terminals, with Terminal 1 having a total of 15 boarding gates, and Terminal 2 having a total of 18 boarding gates. Terminal 1 boarding gates are marked by the Letter "A" (A1-A15) whereas Terminal 2 boarding gates are marked by the Letter "B" (B1-B18), bringing the total number of boarding gates to 33.

In addition, all 33 boarding gates serve a single north-south oriented runway which is 3'000m long and paved by concrete. However, instead of the conventional 18/36, the runway number is denoted as (08/26), which typically stands for a east-west oriented runway.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station to be built in Season 4, as well as the first instance after Season 1 in which a new station is featured in Episode 1.
  • This Station does not feature any structure on the ground level.
  • The letter "U" in the station code refers to Systematic Element Name of Uni, which is associated with the number "1".
  • This Station is sister stations with Mayler Airport 2 Station. Besides of the usage of Brown Wool in both stations and their similar station layouts, the color of the concrete and the other colored wool also correspond to each other. This station uses Light Blue Concrete and Yellow Wool. whereas Mayler Airport 2 Station uses Yellow Concrete and Light Blue Wool.

History[]

  • August 29 2024: This Station began construction.
  • August 31 2024: This Station completed construction.[2]
  • September 4 2024: This station began services alongside Lima Line, but Skyward Line Platforms remain reserved.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Begins with a Single Step.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "From Abyss to Aether".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Begins with a Single Step 02:29

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station does not feature any structure on the ground level.
  • The letter "B" in the station code refers to Systematic Element Name of Bi, which is associated with the number "2".
  • This Station is sister stations with Mayler Airport 1 Station. Besides of the usage of Brown Wool in both stations and their similar station layouts, the color of the concrete and the other colored wool also correspond to each other. This station uses Yellow Concrete and Yellow Concrete. whereas Mayler Airport 1 Station uses Light Blue Concrete and Yellow Wool.
  • The sidings at the south of this station is shared by both Skyward Line and Swift Line.
  • The section between this station and Mayler Airport 1 Station for Skyward Line is running at the speed of msp 1 (30km/h), joining the section of Alpha Line inside Zootuary restricted area as one of the slowest sections in Los Sengas Division of Nazca Railway.

History[]

  • October 6 2024: This Station began construction.
  • October 8 2024: This Station completed construction.[2]
  • October 20 2024: This station began services for both Skyward Line and Swift Line.

Mayler Airport Station NR Dex (Front)

Mayler Airport Station NR Dex (Back)

Mayler Airport Station was a station on Arcgo Line. Before its demolition due to Delta Line works, it was operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and was located at Los Sengas Sava.

Station Floors and Facilities (When This Station Existed)[]

Platforms (B2, Y=40)[3]

Arcgo Line To Thin River (Mayler) →

Platform 2: Arcgo Line To Thin River (Right Side Open)
Platform 1: Arcgo Line To Landing Pole (Right Side Open)

← Arcgo Line To Landing Pole (Jayler)

Fun Facts[]

  • While this station was built in Season 1, Episode 7 and had plans to go in service after the completion of the passenger terminal of Mayler Airport, due to changes in plans, the terminal construction project was cancelled. This station was demolished altogether on May 16 2016 due to Delta Line works.
  • However, After a few years, Mayler Airport works have begun seeing progress, and a concept of a new Mayler Airport Station had begun to emerge, Hence, plans to build a new station in the Airport had been put in place. Subsequently, it is confirmed that one new station would be set in each of the two terminals, with the Station at Terminal 1 serving Skyward Line and Lima Line, and the Station at Terminal 2 serving Skyward Line and Swift Line.
  • Maysang West Station of Phoenix Line and Skyward Line uses the same building materials as this station in response to it being part of the new Mayler Airport plan.

Citations and References[]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Austere Aviation.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Gleams Between the Rails".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Austere Aviation 01:34
Runway Lights in Solitude 03:25

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Find the Password based on the four hints given. The password signs can be found across Mayler Airport.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a Golden Axe.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Sequence
    • Flying

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Only One Player is Required.
  • You may want to Press the Sequence Button at the other end before flying through the five different loops.
  • Obtain the Elytra and the two Fireworks provided. You don't have to fly through all the loops in one go
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Feather.

Fun Facts[]

  • As Mayler Airport does not have its own station yet, this station is recommended by Nazca Railway as the station at which passengers to and from Mayler Airport can disembark.
  • At the time of the station's construction and completion, this station was formerly connected to the old Mayler Airport Station before proceeding to Jayler Station. However, due to Mayler Airport expansion and Delta Line works, that station was never put into use and was demolished.

History[]

  • June 12 2015: This station began services.
  • May 16 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • December 30 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[4]
  • October 7 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
  • December 24 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • July 8 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.
  • December 28 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[6]

Maysang West Station is a station on Skyward Line and Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 210 (Maysang West NR Station Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • The concept of this station first appeared in 2020 when it was announced on the Project Nazca Discord Server that one of the Strategic Lines (Now Phoenix Line) will pass through Mayler Airport.
  • This station uses the same building materials as the former Arcgo Line Mayler Airport Station in response to this station being part of the new Mayler Airport plan.
  • At the time of the construction of this station, The Skyward Line Platforms were sealed off as Skyward Line was not yet in use. This arrangement was similar to that of Quad-Entryway Station and Europa Checkpoint before the Stadow Line extension to these stations.

History[]

  • April 24 2023: This Station began construction.
  • May 4 2023: This Station completed construction.
  • May 5 2023: This Station began services alongside Phoenix Line, but Skyward Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • September 19 2024: This station began expansion of the Skyward Line Part.
  • September 20 2024: This station completed setting up of Skyward Line systems.[2]
  • September 21 2024: Skyward Line extends from Jayler Station to Mayler Airport 1 Station through this station. Skyward Line is established.
  • June 7 2024: Exit E is added to this station to connect to Maysang West NR Station Stop.[3]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station was chosen as the venue of the Project Nazca seventh anniversary fireworks show.

History[]

  • June 13 2019: Nazca Railway announced delays to this station.[2]
  • June 24 2019: This station began construction.[3]
  • June 30 2019: The Platforms of this station completed construction.[4]
  • July 1 2019: This station completed expansion.[5]
  • July 2 2019: This station began services alongside Metropolis Link and Media City Link.
  • May 5 2020: Prosand Link began operations.
  • October 19 2021: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]

Fun Facts[]

  • During planning stages, this station was named Middle Paw Station.[2]
  • This station is named to commemorate the incident in which the MTR mistyped several of its station names after an incident had occurred at Mei Foo Station.[3] around two months before this station was constructed.[4] As a result, this station also uses the color blue as its main color scheme to allude to Mei Foo Station.
  • The original Station Number of Urban Line for this station is 03-3, but due to the completion of Seraphynx Station, it is modified to 04-3.
  • The Throne of Mei Foo exists at this station to allude to the Chinese Name of this Station.

History[]

  • September 23 2018: This station began construction.
  • September 24 2018: This station began services alongside Urban Line. At the same day, this station is chosen as the venue for the Mid-Autumn Festival backshot.[5]
  • July 22 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • August 25 2020: This station completed the first expansion. During the expansion, a set of Akashi Line Platforms are added to the sides of the Urban Line Platforms, turning the Urban Line side platforms into island paltforms.
  • August 26 2020: Akashi Line extends from Minstrel Woods Station to this station.
  • July 14 2022: This station completed the second expansion. During the expansion, a concourse and Exit E are added to this station.[7]
  • May 16 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • March 12 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[8]
  • May 28 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

title: Melody
safeHtml:
Melody is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central North Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-05.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing
    • 2.1 Public Housing

History[]

There has been speculation regarding the origins of the name Melody. One of them has to do with paying homage to Georgina Chan, a member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other symbolizes the fact that this district was the birthplace of a musician who was good at crafting mesmerizing melodies that bring joy to its listeners.

Early on in the planning phases, a Major Shopping mall and a Topside Development has already been planned for this Sub-District. While the source of inspiration was unknown at the time, what was clear was that there will be a shopping mall in this Sub-District to gather visitors. Subseqeuntly, Ocean Pride in West Tseun Wan District was chosen as the inspiration of that Shopping Mall, and a replica of Ocean Pride was hence built in this District, complete with a reserved Railway Exit within the Shopping Mall Structure. As a homage to Ocean Pride, this Shopping Mall Project is named "Collar Pride".

It should be noted that Kam Leung Estate, despite being located in this Sub-District, is administered by the Arctic Sea Sub-District, and can be seen as an Exclave of Arctic Sea Sub-District within this Sub-District.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station adopts a one-way passenger flow system in the regards that Passengers can only enter the Station from Exit B and leave the Station from Exit A. This is due to the fact that the existing Route 0 and Route 8 intersects at the vicinity of this station, which in turn resulted in the station having two concourses.[4]
  • The livery of this station (#FFB347) is provided by ChatGPT.

Future Development[]

  • The Los Sengas Government Headquarters will be built at the North of Memorial Park.

History[]

  • March 23 2023: This Station began construction.
  • March 28 2023: This Station completed construction.
  • March 30 2023: This Station began services.
